messages:
nora: quick heads-up - customer canary failed on our rerank endpoint after we rolled the new batching helper into sampleapp-canary. stack snippet:
```
Error: dot product failed: dims 1536 vs 768
at rerank_pipeline.go:142
```

nora: they run a mix of services: some with node-sampleapp (sdk 0.8.0, batching helper pad_to_max=true) and others on python-sampleapp (sdk 0.6.3, pad_to_max=false). result: mixed candidate_embeddings in a single rerank call
sam: thanks. is this strictly padding, or different model dims?
tia: quick check - it's padding in this case. model returns 768, node batcher pads to 1536 (internal pad_to_max behavior + max found in the batch). python didn't pad so we end up with a mix
sam: ugh. two correlated issues we keep seeing: (1) SDK default drift for pad_to_max across languages, (2) rerank not validating input dims and failing in an unfriendly way. also saw auth-refresh retries duplicating batches which can interleave padded/non-padded versions
sdk-bot: created issue RED-DEA-711: "embed dim parity + rerank validation" assigned to @sam
nora: short-term mitigation rolled as hotfix: sampleapp now asserts uniform embedding length before calling rerank and returns a clearly-worded client error: 
```
EMB_DIM_MISMATCH: found lengths [768,1536]. Hint: check sdk.pad_to_max and model version.
```
ops-cam: pushed the hotfix to canary and customer confirmed it stopped the crashes. logged the diagnostic bundle for investigation
tia: medium-term proposals: (a) include "embedding_dim" in EmbeddingResponse for both single and batch endpoints, (b) rerank should validate uniform dims server-side and return structured code EMB_DIM_MISMATCH with guidance, (c) add idempotency_token to batch requests to prevent retry-dup scenarios during auth refresh, (d) standardize pad_to_max default across SDKs (prefer false)
sam: I'll open SDK PRs to: expose embedding_dim in responses, print dims in sampleapps on create, and align pad_to_max defaults. will also add a small interop CI test that runs Node+Python sampleapps concurrently against a fake rerank to catch parity regressions
nora: created PR for hotfix in sampleapp: github.com/redwood/sampleapp/pull/701 (includes assert + clearer error message). CI green
sdk-bot: sampleapp PR #701 passed CI :white_check_mark:
tia: ops followups: add server-side request logging for client sdk/version + pad flag (PII-safe) to speed support triage. add runbook snippet for on-call to check embedding_dim when rerank errors appear
sam: one more UX ask: onboarding docs & quickstart should print the returned embedding_dim after create so users notice model changes immediately rather than later during rerank
nora: agreed. i'll draft the onboarding blurb and include a snippet showing how to call metadata endpoint for model dims
sdk-bot: linking followups: RED-DEA-711 (sdk parity), RED-DEA-712 (rerank validation & error codes), RED-DEA-713 (batch idempotency)
ops-cam: closing loop for now 1: customer canary stable after hotfix. we'll monitor next 48h
